hook: Petar Veličković earned a Master of Arts with First Class Honours in Computer Science from the University of Cambridge in 2015, then stayed at Cambridge for a PhD in computer science at Trinity College, completed in 2019 under the supervision of Pietro Liò, with a thesis on the resurgence of structure in deep neural networks. During his doctorate he interned at Nokia Bell Labs and Jane Street and worked as a visiting researcher at the Mila Quebec AI Institute. In 2017 he led the team that introduced Graph Attention Networks, a neural architecture that lets nodes in a graph weigh the importance of their neighbors using self attention rather than fixed graph convolutions. He joined Google DeepMind in London in 2019, rising to Senior Staff Research Scientist, while remaining an Affiliated Lecturer at Cambridge, where he co-teaches a graduate course on geometric deep learning. His later work has applied graph neural networks to problems including travel time prediction in Google Maps and neural algorithmic reasoning, which studies how neural networks can learn to execute classical algorithms.

timeline.event: Completed a Master of Arts with First Class Honours in Computer Science at the University of Cambridge

timeline.impact: Recognized his standing in the European machine learning research community.

achievements.title: Co-invented Graph Attention Networks
achievements.impact: Introduced masked self attention layers for graph structured data, letting nodes weigh neighbors unevenly without costly matrix operations, and became one of the most widely used graph neural network architectures.

achievements.title: Advanced neural algorithmic reasoning
achievements.impact: Helped establish a research direction that trains neural networks to imitate and generalize classical algorithms, improving out of distribution reasoning.

achievements.title: Applied graph neural networks to Google Maps
achievements.impact: Contributed graph learning techniques used to improve travel time estimates for hundreds of millions of users.

achievements.title: Co-developed Deep Graph Infomax
achievements.impact: Created a self supervised learning method for graph representations that does not require labeled data.
